name: computer_use
description: Control the computer AND render-verify web pages. Two distinct screenshot modes: (1) action=screenshot captures the live DESKTOP (whole screen or x/y/x2/y2 region) — use it to see what the user sees, inspect a GUI app, or verify a native window; (2) action=web_screenshot captures a WEB PAGE with headless Chromium/Playwright — pass url, and optionally width/height/full_page/device_scale_factor/dark_mode/wait_for_selector/delay. USE web_screenshot to actually LOOK at any HTML you or the user produced (a render_html block, a generated file, localhost:5173, a live site) instead of assuming it rendered correctly. Also: mouse move/click/drag/scroll, keyboard type/key, window list/focus/resize/close, clipboard get/set, screen_info, screen_parse (accessibility tree), and web_browser for a persistent Chromium (status/start/close, keeps cookies+login between calls). Works on Windows and Linux (X11 + Wayland).

action.description: The action to perform. Use web_screenshot to capture a web page (headless Chromium/Playwright, not the desktop), and web_browser to manage the one persistent browser instance.

url.description: For web_screenshot: page URL. https:// is added automatically if the scheme is missing.

delay.description: For web_screenshot: seconds to wait AFTER the page loads before capturing (lets JS/animations/fonts settle). Default 1.5. Use 0 to shoot immediately.

wait_until.description: For web_screenshot: navigation event to wait for. 'networkidle' = no network for 500ms (best for SPAs). Default 'load'.

wait_for_selector.description: For web_screenshot: CSS selector to wait for before capturing (e.g. '.chart-loaded').

width.description: For web_screenshot: viewport width in px. Default 1440.

height.description: For web_screenshot: viewport height in px. Default 900.

full_page.description: For web_screenshot: capture the entire scrollable page (true, default) or just the viewport (false).

headless.description: For web_screenshot/web_browser: run Chromium without a visible window. Default true.

timeout_ms.description: For web_screenshot: navigation/selector timeout in milliseconds. Default 30000.

device_scale_factor.description: For web_screenshot: pixel density. 2 = retina-sharp PNG. Default 1.

user_agent.description: For web_screenshot: override the User-Agent string.

dark_mode.description: For web_screenshot: emulate prefers-color-scheme: dark. Default false.

keep_alive.description: For web_screenshot: keep ONE Chromium instance running between calls so the next run reuses it (cookies, login, tabs persist). Default false. Use web_browser op=close to shut it down.

fresh_page.description: For web_screenshot with keep_alive: open a new tab instead of reusing the last one. Default false.

cdp_port.description: For web_screenshot/web_browser: remote-debugging port of the persistent browser. Default 9222.

user_data_dir.description: For web_screenshot/web_browser: Chrome profile directory for the persistent browser. Default ~/sable_output/browser/profile.

op.description: For web_browser: status = is the persistent browser up + list its pages; start = launch it without taking a screenshot; close = kill it.

pages.description: For web_browser op=status: include the open page URLs. Default true.

x.description: X coordinate (pixels from left). For screenshot region, mouse_move, mouse_click, mouse_drag start.

y.description: Y coordinate (pixels from top). For screenshot region, mouse_move, mouse_click, mouse_drag start.

x2.description: End X for mouse_drag or width for screenshot region / window_resize.

y2.description: End Y for mouse_drag or height for screenshot region / window_resize.

button.description: Mouse button for click. Default: left.

text.description: Text to type (keyboard_type) or clipboard content (clipboard_set).

window_id.description: Window ID or title for window_focus, window_resize, window_close.

save_path.description: File path to save screenshot. Default: auto-generated in output dir.

fullscreen.description: Screenshot entire screen (true) or use x/y/x2/y2 region. Default: true.

filter_type.description: For screen_parse: filter elements by control type (e.g. 'Button', 'Edit', 'Text'). Omit for all.

max_elements.description: For screen_parse: max elements to return. Default: 50.
